# Kydon

> Kydon is where people and AI learn, and learn to work together. Kydon ZilLearn is the learning and performance platform for people and AI agents: whatever agents your teams use, your people and your agents learn from each other, so performance keeps improving long after go-live. Founded in Singapore in 2012.

## Company overview

- **Name:** Kydon Holdings
- **Founded:** 2012, Singapore
- **Headquarters:** 2 Science Park Drive, Ascent #01-32, Singapore 118222
- **Works across:** Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, India and Australia
- **Website:** https://www.kydongrp.com
- **Tagline:** Where people and AI learn, and learn to work together.

## What Kydon offers

### Kydon ZilLearn
The learning and performance platform for people and AI agents. It sits across every agent your teams use and makes people and AI learn from each other.
- URL: https://www.kydongrp.com/platform

### AI Learning Platform
Capability of Kydon ZilLearn where your people learn: personalised pathways, answers in the flow of work and live insight into skills.
- URL: https://www.kydongrp.com/ai-learning-platform

### Kydon Intelligence
Capability of Kydon ZilLearn that helps the whole organisation monitor change, understand what it means and decide with evidence.
- URL: https://www.kydongrp.com/kydon-intelligence

### AI Co-Workers
Ready-built AI roles that take on routine work so people can do more of what only people can. Each is run inside your team by a Forward Deployed Operator.
- URL: https://www.kydongrp.com/ai-co-workers

### AI Workforce Factory™
The talent engine behind Kydon ZilLearn. It trains Forward Deployed Operators, deploys them with clients and feeds what is learnt back into training.
- URL: https://www.kydongrp.com/ai-workforce-factory

### Kydon Learning Systems Institute
Kydon's learning and development institute.
- URL: https://lsi.kydongrp.com
